---
title: "User's Guide"
---
 
The User's Guide provides conceptual background and practical tutorials for 
using bgms.

## Contents

- [Getting Started](getting-started.qmd) — Installation and first steps
- [Ordinal MRF](omrf.qmd) — Understanding the ordinal Markov random field
- [GGM](ggm.qmd) — Gaussian graphical models for continuous data
- [Edge Selection](edge-selection.qmd) — Spike-and-slab priors for structure learning
- [Group Comparison](group-comparison.qmd) — Comparing networks with bgmCompare
- [Prior Guide](prior-guide.qmd) — Choosing priors for your analysis

## Prerequisites

This guide assumes basic familiarity with:

- R programming
- Bayesian inference concepts
- Graphical models / network analysis

For background on Bayesian analysis of psychological networks, see 
[Huth et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1177/25152459231193334).
